topics.title: King’s Alleged Infidelity Revealed
topics.summary: During the broadcast, excerpts from Ralph Abernathy's biography detail allegations of infidelity on Martin Luther King Jr.’s part, including multiple encounters with women and arguments over temptation. The conversation shifts to discussing news while acknowledging these revelations, highlighting complexities surrounding historical figures.

topics.title: Police Investigations, Racial Slurs & Diamond Sales
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Howard makes racially charged remarks about "poor black folks" and white women. The discussion shifts to a police investigation involving arrests related to attacks on Jewish college students including Joseph Gubin, before transitioning into an advertisement for Honda’s new Accord with emphasis on its size and features followed by Robin's eighth annual diamond sale.

topics.title: Diamond Sales and Campaign Manager Frustration
topics.summary: Robin promotes discounted diamonds with financing options, while Howard attempts to secure a mayoral candidate’s endorsement via telephone. He encounters bureaucratic delays and frustrating interactions involving campaign managers and ultimately fails to connect directly with the desired contact.

topics.title: Radio Host Arrest & Odd Conversations
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio segment, hosts discuss an arrest involving Sam Kennison for disruptive behavior at a coffee shop and rumors about his family’s past including marijuana use and interactions with Dick Clark. They also feature a commercial break promoting Snapple while discussing bizarre conversations and personal anecdotes.

topics.title: Snapple Promotion & Hollywood Arrest
topics.summary: During a WYSP Morning Show, hosts discuss the Snapple promotion and available stores while simultaneously covering an unusual arrest involving comedian Andrew Dice Clay in Los Angeles. Police confusion regarding details leads to calls for confirmation, with Sam Kinison observing the event.

topics.title: Tape Trading and Godzilla Sightings
topics.summary: During an interview segment, a man discusses buying a tape from someone who won a contest. The conversation quickly devolves into bizarre tangents involving celebrity sightings (Eddie Fisher), accusations of manipulation by show business figures, and a reported sighting of a large green being near Harlem confirmed by the local police commissioner.
